metadata.description: Oh-My-Pi plugins: an agentic dev team, a GitHub Copilot model preset, a token-reduction toolkit, an Azure DevOps filesystem, a CLIProxyAPI provider, and Datadog observability.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Agentic dev team (port of bdfinst/agentic-dev-team): orchestrator + 32 specialist/critic agents, the specs->plan->build->pr workflow, strict TDD and human gates, ~78 skills, and blocking guard extensions. All-cloud tiers.

plugins.name: azure-devops-fs
plugins.description: Azure DevOps as a filesystem for OMP: read repos/files/PRs/diffs via ado:// URIs, create/checkout/push PRs, comment/vote, watch pipelines. Standalone, PAT-authenticated, with a SQLite read cache.

plugins.name: copilot-preset
plugins.description: Ready, solid-but-cheap model configuration that routes OMP (and the dev-team) through GitHub Copilot, so teams run on their Copilot license. Config-only: paste the snippet; tier -> Copilot model mapping, post-2026-06-01 AI-credit/token pricing comparison, and MAI-Code-1-Flash ('MIA Coding') wired in for when it lands.

plugins.name: token-diet
plugins.description: Aggressive token reduction: ctx-wire for transparently compressed + secret-scrubbed shell output, context-mode output sandboxing, CodeGraph (MCP) for symbol/call-graph queries instead of grep+read, caveman terse-output + yagni minimal-code skills, plus context-transform extensions (lossless read-dedup + context-dedup on by default; protect-masked context-compress at safe by default, the quality-preserving take on caveman-code's LLMLingua/Provence). Layers on OMP's native compaction + astGrep; ships an always-on routing rule, MCP config, skills, extensions, and a setup script.

plugins.name: cliproxy
plugins.description: Register a CLIProxyAPI gateway (router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) as an OpenAI-compatible model provider. You supply the gateway URL + API key; the installer lists the models and writes a 'cliproxy' provider into ~/.omp/agent/models.yml with runtime discovery, so any upstream the gateway exposes is usable as cliproxy/<model-id>.

plugins.name: datadog
plugins.description: Datadog observability from the terminal via the Datadog 'pup' CLI (DataDog/pup): logs, metrics, traces/APM, monitors, incidents, dashboards, SLOs, synthetics, RUM, security/audit, CI test visibility, and LLM/agent observability. One broad 'datadog' skill drives pup (which embeds Datadog's domain skills) instead of flooding OMP. Installer sets up pup + auth.
